purpose: Patch the Raichu/Electrode omission in agent13-newmoon-candidate-policy-acceptance-v1 without changing the 60.
status: paper/actor-visible acceptance delta only; no native game or competitive qualification

cases.state: Opposing Klefki is Active; opposing Electrode-GX is Benched and otherwise able to use Extra Energy Bomb; candidate Mewtwo & Mew-GX and Lunatone Abilities are relevant.
cases.must: Recognize Klefki suppresses Basic Perfection and Basic New Moon, but does not suppress Stage-1 Electrode-GX.
cases.forbids: Treating opposing Klefki as symmetrical shutdown of Electrode-GX or treating Lunatone as active under Klefki.

cases.state: Native Gengar & Mimikyu-GX is attack-ready with GX unused; Path to the Peak is playable; opposing Electrode-GX is live; no actor-visible board-only Stadium removal is established.
cases.must: Compare Path -> native Horror House-GX against Cologne/Perfection, crediting Path's suppression of Electrode and Horror House's denial of hand-played Stadium/evolution answers.
cases.forbids: Requiring Perfection or Cologne merely because opposing Klefki suppresses Mewtwo.

cases.state: Rank-17 Marshadow UNB 81 is already on the Bench while Path/Horror House is being considered.
cases.must: Expect Resetting Hole to remain a board Ability that can discard Path despite Horror House.
cases.forbids: Conflating hand lock with in-play Ability lock.

cases.state: A legal TPE/Bench choice would add unnecessary low-HP or multi-Prize bodies while the source can plausibly reach a Telescopic-Sight Electro Rain Bomb turn.
cases.must: Allow 0/1 TPE targets and price each Bench body by Electro Rain packets-to-KO plus Prize yield; prefer discard-zone Gengar donor over an unnecessary Benched donor when legal.
cases.forbids: Maximizing Bench/search connectivity without scoring distributed Prize conversion.

cases.state: No Prize changes yet; both candidate Dusclops can use Cursed Blast and self-KO before the opponent's first Electrode Bomb; their counter placement does not take an opposing Prize.
cases.must: Recognize two self-KOs make the first Bomb restore 4-4 Prize parity, so Reversal/Counter Energy Prize-deficit multipliers are off after that Bomb unless another Prize change occurs.
cases.forbids: Assuming the first Bomb always activates Reversal/Counter multipliers.

cases.state: Exactly one candidate Cursed Blast self-KO occurred before the opponent's first Electrode Bomb and no other Prize changes occurred.
cases.must: Recognize the post-Bomb state is candidate 4 Prizes remaining vs Raichu 5, so Raichu is still behind and Reversal/Counter multipliers remain live.
cases.forbids: Treating one self-KO as sufficient Prize-parity control.

cases.state: Candidate goes second on its first turn; Horror House-GX is legal; opponent has not yet legally evolved Voltorb/Pikachu on its first turn.
cases.must: Value Horror House as denial of the next hand-play evolution/Bomb-combo turn, not merely generic hand disruption.
cases.forbids: Waiting for Electrode/Raichu to exist before valuing the lock.

arithmeticWitness.condition: 4 Reversal Energy + 1 Counter Energy attached to non-Rule-Box Evolution Alolan Raichu while Raichu has more Prizes remaining
arithmeticWitness.sixPrizeBenchExample: Benched Gengar & Mimikyu-GX: 7 selections with Telescopic Sight + Benched Tapu Lele-GX: 5 + one 60-HP Unown/Duskull: 2 = 14 selections and 6 nominal Prizes
arithmeticWitness.caveat: Source-inventory/board frontier only, not frequency or win probability.
